fields.description: Sobha Aquamont is a three-tower beachfront development in Downtown Umm Al Quwain. It combines one- and two-bedroom apartments with three-bedroom duplexes; balcony, yard and duplex arrangements differ across Towers A, B and C.

research.community: Sobha Aquamont · Downtown Umm Al Quwain
overview: The fact book specifies porcelain floors, fitted kitchen appliances and provisions for smart lighting and temperature control. It also describes district cooling. Confirm the final specification and operating charges in the contract; furnishing shown in renderings is illustrative.
Clubhouse facilities are distinct from the wider masterplan’s beach, marina and linear park. Opening dates, access conditions and additional charges need confirmation.
research.locationNote: Downtown Umm Al Quwain, within the wider coastal masterplan. The one-pager describes access via E 11 and E 311; promotional driving times vary with the actual route and traffic.
research.priceNote: Sobha currently advertises AED 1.11 m subject to inventory. The branded one-pager lists historic starting guides of AED 1.11 m for one bedroom, AED 1.44 m for two bedrooms and AED 4.30 m for three bedrooms. These are not current unit offers.
research.paymentNote: The branded one-pager states 60% during construction and 40% on completion. Property Finder describes 20% launch down payment plus 40% construction and 40% handover. No current dated instalment calendar was retrieved; charges and remaining balances require a unit-specific offer.
research.handoverNote: The branded one-pager and fact book indicate anticipatedJune 2028 completion. This is a marketing estimate, not a signed delivery guarantee.
